_doc: The weekly meeting. The bell rings at `hour` on every `every_days`-th day; adults come if nothing urgent keeps them away. People talk for `length_hours`; what they agree becomes the colony plan (at most `plan_items` things), which lasts until the next meeting. Without a meeting hall they meet at the campfire. Before there is a hall, the campfire seats meeting_seats (data/buildings.json); a gathering that doesn't fit is what makes people want a hall. Each plan item gets about volunteer_share of the people there (at least 1, at most max_volunteers), one job each.
